headline: OpenAI reports Pando, a Git-compatible backend built for monorepo and agent-scale traffic
summary: In a 2 November 2026 engineering report, OpenAI describes Pando, a backend that it says now serves all development on its monorepo while retaining compatibility with the Git protocol and client. Its design stores incoming packs as immutable blobs, tracks per-branch ref versions and dependencies, permits unrelated branch writes to proceed independently, and reuses stored packs for fetches. OpenAI reports nearly fivefold lower median push latency and nearly one petabyte of Git data delivered per day in production. These operational figures and deployment details are first-party claims; the article supplies no independently inspected workload traces or external reproduction. The article separately labels its architecture comparison as synthetic teaching simulations rather than production benchmarks.
